children: India's Tata Trusts said on Thursday it has not agreed to the listing of Tata Sons and asked the conglomerate's holding company to explore all available options other than a public listing.

Earlier in the day, Reuters reported that the board of Tata Sons said it would consider a listing, after the Reserve Bank of India rejected its request for an exemption from rules requiring it to list.
